summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by HUYA Inc., a foreign private issuer, announcing that it has filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The press release confirms the filing with the SEC and provides access details. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine periodic report filing with no event-driven corporate action.
